an10.110:1.4: ye ca micchādiṭṭhipaccayā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti, te c' assa niddhantā honti,
an10.110:1.5: sammādiṭṭhipaccayā ca aneke kusalā dhammā bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchanti.
an10.110:3.2: ye ca micchāvimuttipaccayā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti, te c' assa niddhantā honti,
an10.110:3.3: sammāvimuttipaccayā ca aneke kusalā dhammā bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchanti.
an10.110:3.4: Ime kho bhikkhave dasa niddhamaniyā dhammā
